rows.label: American Samoa Minimum Tax: 4% of adjusted gross income
rows.note: adjusted gross income (Form 390 line 34); the total tax is the larger of the regular tax and this minimum tax (lines 43 to 45). Form 390 adds the minimum tax (line 43) to the regular tax less the minimum tax, never below zero (line 44), so the tax due is at least 4% of adjusted gross income. P.L. 27-13 tax-exempt income is reported on line 7b and a worksheet applies where it does.
